item.title: Labor unions fight against housing for UC Berkeley students
item.description: Unions are trying to stop an affordable housing project aimed at college students unless certain demands are met.

item.title: Gen Z’ers ‘hungry for truth’: Record 52 students join Catholic Church at ASU
item.description: While Gen Z leads the rise of the religiously unaffiliated, Arizona State University is bucking the trend with a record 52 new Catholics this semester. The school’s All Saints Catholic Newman Center recently welcomed 52 students into the Church and expects a similar number of students to join in the spring. Director of Campus Ministry […]

item.title: White professor still fighting in court, alleging ‘racially hostile’ environment at Penn State
item.description: Zack De Piero, a former professor at Penn State, is appealing the dismissal of his lawsuit alleging a "racially hostile" environment due to the university's DEI trainings and race-based grading.

item.title: Victim in Brown U. shooting ID’d as college Republicans VP, Catholic: ‘Faithful bright light’
item.description: 'Tragically, one of our parishioners, Ella Cook, was one of those who was killed yesterday.'

item.title: MIT blames new endowment tax for decision to close multiple libraries
item.description: MIT plans to close two libraries due to a $300 million budget deficit, which it blames partly on the new 8% endowment tax.

item.title: UChicago refuses to cancel Biden official for being pro-Israel
item.description: Pro-Palestinian activists want to see a Biden official cancel at the University of Chicago for his role in Israel-Palestine policy. The school won't budge.

item.title: Young women’s complaints prompt Michigan State U. to restore single-sex dorm showers
item.description: After female residents at Michigan State University expressed discomfort with new "gender neutral" bathrooms, including shower areas, the university restored some to single-sex spaces.

item.title: UC Berkeley, Pomona College reach deals with Jewish groups over antisemitism claims
item.description: Two California universities reached settlements with Jewish advocacy groups over antisemitism allegations this month. The University of California Berkeley will pay $60,000 to Israeli sociologist and dance researcher Yael Nativ, according to a news release from the Louis D. Brandeis Center, which filed the lawsuit. item.description: Not 'all about sex': Some experts, students defend college furry clubs' creative core.

item.title: Brown U. shooter remains at large as authorities release new videos, offer $50K reward
